newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Kinnevik unit to invest 460 mln skr.
newsitem.headline: Kinnevik unit to invest 460 mln skr.

text.p: Korsnas, the forestry products division of Swedish media concern Industriforvaltnings AB Kinnevik, said on Wednesday it would invest 460 million crowns to rebuild a paper board making machine in Gavle, Sweden.
"The investments will result in further quality improvements and increase the machine's capacity by about 60,000 tonnes annually," Korsnas said in a statement.
The machine produces mostly paper board for drinks packaging and reinforced white paper board.
The improvements will be carried out in autumn 1998.
